summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of NSS NMAMIT app. 33/33 backend pytest tests passing (100%): auth (email/USN/wrong pw), role-based access (user vs member vs admin vs super_admin), events public listing/detail/reg-status, member registration + duplicate 409 + terms required, payments returning configured=false and 503 (expected - Razorpay keys not provided), admin members CRUD + search + import path, admin events CRUD + registrations, admin attendance mark/get, admin certificate upload+issue+public verify+delete-invalidates, gallery CRUD + public, transactions + accounts summary, super-admin admin lifecycle (create admin+super_admin, cannot delete self 400, patch), roles CRUD, audit logs, files upload/download. Frontend smoke: Home renders with NSS+NMAMIT logos in header, super admin login redirects to /admin, member (USN 4NM22CS089) login redirects to /profile, Super Admin page /admin/super loads with admins/roles/logs tabs and tab switching works, Verify page loads with input + search. Payments 503 and email skips are expected states (keys not provided) - not bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout logic works but response is 401 for the 5th failed attempt; only the 6th attempt sees 429. Consider returning 429 on the attempt that triggers the lockout.

core.py get_current_user reads cookie 'access_token' but /auth/login only returns token in body (no Set-Cookie). Cookie-based auth flow is dead code - either remove or set the cookie on login for consistency.
api.py login: locked_until is set twice (bug-shape but final value correct); tidy up unused first assignment.
api.py _reg_status returns 'compulsory' status but frontend logic treats can_register=false correctly. OK.
Consider adding pagination for /admin/members and /admin/events/{id}/registrations (currently limit 1000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Payments create-order returns 503 by design until Razorpay keys are added to backend/.env. Brevo emails are logged, not sent. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. All admin pages use data-testid; SuperAdmin.js has tab-admins/tab-roles/tab-logs and admin-create-btn/admin-form-* selectors. To test event cards, inspect Events.js for correct card link pattern.
